name: Web NFC
plain: Lets a site read and write NFC tags when the phone touches one.
meaning: Reads tag messages (URLs, text, ids) and can write or lock them. A site can learn which tags the person tapped, for payments tags, tickets or inventory.

web.api: new NDEFReader().scan(), reader.onreading, new NDEFWriter()/ndef.write(), makeReadOnly()

access.prompt_ui: Permission prompt, plus a system NFC on setting; page must be in foreground
access.iframe: Top level and same origin only; cross-origin iframes blocked
steps: onreading delivers serialNumber and NDEF records

fields.name: records[].recordType
fields.range: text, url, mime, smart-poster, absolute-url, external, unknown

fields.name: records[].data
fields.range: tag capacity (NTAG213 144 B, NTAG215 504 B, NTAG216 888 B)

limits.headline: Can scan NFC tags and save to them when your phone touches one
limits.user_action: You tap Scan or Save, allow NFC, then hold your phone near a tag.
can: Scan a tag your phone touches
Save text or a link onto a tag
Work only while the page is open and in front
cannot: Work in the background or when the page is hidden
Work if NFC is turned off in your phone settings
Work on iPhone, or in Firefox or Safari
Use your phone's wallet or payment cards
limits.differs: Only Chrome on Android supports it. iPhone does not.

story.what_it_is: A site can read or write NFC tags when your phone touches one.

marketing.name: Web NFC
marketing.pitch: Chrome's docs say Web NFC lets pages read and write NFC tags, on Android.

story.for_you: You tap your phone on a tag, and the web page shows what is on it. It only works while the page is open on screen.
story.for_makers: Makers get tag based tools with no app: tickets, inventory and smart posters. It is Chrome for Android only.

use_cases.example: An event site checks in guests by tapping an NFC wristband.
A tag on a product opens a page with sizes and reviews.
A hotel room tag opens the check in page.
A treasure hunt site reads tags around a museum.
A repair crew taps a tag on a machine to load its service log.
A fake tag could point you to a bad site.

technical_bounds: Only NDEF formatted tags, no card emulation or raw ISO-DEP
Only while page is visible and focused
Android only: no desktop, no iOS, no Safari, no Firefox

abuse: Writing hostile tags that launch URLs

history.change: Web NFC ships on Chrome Android 89
